findings.evidence: As `apply_spatial_n` shows `g (F.spatial p) F.n = 0`, the spatial projection algebraically maps onto the left orthogonal complement for any bilinear form, symmetric or not.
findings.fix: Remove `hg` and generalize the range to the left orthogonal complement (e.g., using `g.flip.orthogonal (ℝ ∙ F.n)` or equivalent).
findings.issue: `range_spatial` unnecessarily assumes `hg : g.IsSymm` to match the right orthogonal complement.

findings.evidence: The algebraic identity `|p_s| = |E(p)|` holds for all massless momenta, and can be readily proved in general by using the absolute value version of `Real.sqrt_mul_self` (e.g. `Real.sqrt_mul_self_eq_abs`).
findings.fix: Remove `hE` and state the natural general form `F.spatialNorm p = |F.energy p|`.
findings.issue: `spatialNorm_of_massless` unnecessarily assumes `hE : 0 ≤ F.energy p`, restricting to positive-energy momenta.

summary: The PR contains under-generalized statements where natural algebraic identities and geometric properties hold without the current restricting assumptions.
